_comment: Single source of truth for the unified gateway: which upstream serves which
model, and whether that upstream needs the agentrouter filter.
The gateway's /u route dispatches on the request's `model` field, so a client
only needs ONE provider entry (http://127.0.0.1:7878/u/v1) and picks a model.
tools/build-model-catalog.cjs reads this file, so the codex picker and the
gateway can never disagree about which models exist.
`wire`: responses = upstream speaks the Responses API natively (pass through);
chat      = upstream is chat/completions only (the gateway bridges).
`filter`: run filter.mjs (char allowlist + word list + identity rewrite).
Only agentrouter needs it; on other upstreams it only loses fidelity.
`proxy`: CONNECT tunnel, needed by anyrouter.top (TLS-blocked when direct).
_models_comment: key   = the model id the CLIENT sends (also the codex catalog slug)
value = { p: provider, m: upstream model id (omit when identical) }
Only ids that were probed live are listed. Entries whose upstream currently
answers 402/503 stay listed when the id is real (it recovers); the gateway
passes the upstream error through unchanged so the cause stays visible.

models._builtin_comment: codex built-in slugs, served natively by relaycat
